Contiguous source numerals retain script attachment to the whole numeral; numeral content is stored as digit tokens on both sides. Unbraced fraction/script arguments consume one TeX atom. Prose replaces each math expression with the same ordinal marker and compares the entire ordered body after only markup and whitespace normalization; list markers recovered from ol starts; image alt text and link labels compared independently.
